test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**group**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
• **corporation**: a large company or group of companies authorized to act as a single entity and recognized as such in law.
 
• **group: **a number of people or things that are located, gathered or classed together.
 
• **gang: **an organized group of criminals.
 
• **party: **a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, **"group" **is an appropriate word choice for the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**The complete passage is: **During the pandemic, Suren, a regular platelet donor, was stuck outside Mumbai for 14 weeks. A constant thought was the missed donation dates. He **(1) knew** there would be a need because, **(2) despite** the lockdown restrictions, people on chemotherapy were being treated and **(3) would **keep needing platelets. When he returned home, he discovered that the situation was grim as many regular donors **(4) had stopped** coming either out of fear or because travel was difficult. So, he formed a small **(5) group** of donors, arranged for transport and letters from TMC Hospital to validate our travel and they started donating in July 2020.
